parameters.name: Key
parameters.description: The Environment variable name that needs to be passed to the Execution unit when the execution unit is activated.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: The Environment variable value associated with the name that needs to be passed to the Execution unit it is activated.

object.description: This parameter describes the {{object|###.ExecutionUnit.{i}.EnvVariable}} instances which should be present after the update in any {{object|###.ExecutionUnit}} created by this DeploymentUnit. This table supersedes any {{object|###.ExecutionUnit.{i}.EnvVariable}} instances which may have been present before the update.
